entries.name: Eggs and chicken balls on grain toast with hummus and chickpea-capsicum salad

entries.notes: User-supplied weights. Salad photo shows chickpeas/beans as the main component with roasted red capsicum, tomato, red onion and leafy greens; 205 g was visible on the scale photo but user specified 250 g consumed, so 250 g used for the log. Estimated breakdown: salad ~330 kcal / 14 g protein; chicken balls 77 g ~130 kcal / 11 g protein; eggs 130 g ~185 kcal / 16 g protein; two grain toast slices ~180 kcal / 7 g protein; small hummus spread ~35 kcal / 1 g protein.
